subject: Emergency Rental Assistance Funding
overview: The Council met via remote participation to authorize emergency housing funds and discuss municipal financial stability during the COVID-19 pandemic. They approved a partial appropriation for rental assistance while delaying a major sidewalk repair loan for further review.

items.title: Citywide Sidewalk Loan Order
items.summary: Tabled a $500,000 loan order for citywide sidewalk repairs until the administration provides a priority list of streets and details on a potential pilot repair program.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Rental Assistance
items.summary: Approved a modified appropriation of $125,000 for the ABCD rental assistance program and $20,000 for Housing Families Incorporated to provide legal services and aid to Medford residents.

items.title: Congratulatory Resolution: Henry and Evelyn Milleron
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating the Millerons on their 50th wedding anniversary.

items.title: COVID-19 Financial Impact Meeting
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Committee of the Whole to invite the Mayor and Budget Director to discuss the pandemic's impact on the city budget and state aid.

items.title: Committee Reports: CDBG and Marijuana Zoning
items.summary: Accepted committee reports regarding the annual action plan for Community Development Block Grant funding and the progress of marijuana zoning in industrial areas.

items.title: Senior Tax Deferment Program
items.summary: Adopted a committee report to increase the gross receipt limit for the elderly tax deferral program to $50,000 for fiscal year 2021.

items.title: Memorial Resolutions: Senator Shannon and Paul Brogan
items.summary: Approved memorial resolutions honoring the 15th anniversary of the passing of State Senator Charles E. Shannon Jr. and expressing condolences for the passing of Paul Brogan.

items.title: Approval of Records and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved previous meeting records and adjourned in memory of victims of COVID-19.
